summary: Get Started no longer blocks a SuperAdmin who may approve their own break-glass list.

fixes.title: Approve your own break-glass list
fixes.text: In Get Started, with self-approval on, the SuperAdmin who raised the break-glass list can approve it right in the step.

fixes.title: Templates banner shows where to switch
fixes.text: The Templates preview banner now names its switch: Settings > Features & edition > Governance preview.
